solution.brief: Wasp_Basic Part creates WaspPart objects from geometry, connections, and a name string for use in discrete aggregation workflows.
solution.principle:
WaspPart is a container that bundles geometry, connection points, and identity (name) into a single object that aggregation algorithms can reference, place, and track — the name string is the key identifier used in rules to specify which part types connect where.

Related insight: Related insight: When Wasp_Rule references this part's connections, it uses 0-based integer indices corresponding to the sequential order connections were passed into Wasp_Basic Part. The combination of exact part name string + correct 0-based connection index is required for rules to fire — either mismatch causes silent failure.

Related insight: Related insight: WaspPart objects produced by Wasp_Basic Part are consumed by Wasp_Stochastic Aggregation as a required prerequisite input. Geometry is not retrieved directly from the aggregation output — a separate Wasp_Get Part Geometry component must be connected to the PART_OUT output of the aggregation component to extract geometry for visualization.

Related insight: Related insight: The geometry input to Wasp_Basic Part is a Brep (or mesh) referenced from a paired Rhino .3dm file via a GH Brep parameter component. The .3dm must be open in Rhino before the GH file solves. This external-reference model means part geometry lives in Rhino and remains editable there, while aggregation logic lives in GH — but it also means the .3dm is a hard prerequisite for the definition to solve correctly.

intents: how do I create a wasp part for aggregation
what inputs does Wasp_Basic Part need
how to set up a part for discrete aggregation in Wasp
how do I define a building block for wasp stochastic aggregation
what is the wiring pattern for WaspPart
symptoms: WaspPart output shows id: None before aggregation
aggregation component not accepting part input
unsure which geometry to feed into GEO vs COLL inputs
part name not matching rule definitions

preconditions: Wasp plugin is installed in Grasshopper
Part geometry exists as a Brep or Mesh in Rhino or as a GH parameter
At least one WaspConnection object has been created via Wasp_Connection From Direction
A unique string name has been chosen for the part type (used consistently in aggregation rules)

evolution_history.changes: New pattern highlights that both part names AND 0-based connection indices must precisely match — reinforcing the silent failure risk already noted for name strings, now extended to index references.

The new pattern clarifies the downstream role of WaspPart objects (fed into aggregation) and that geometry retrieval from aggregation results requires a dedicated Wasp_Get Part Geometry step, which is not currently documented in this pattern's context.

The new pattern clarifies that the geometry bundled into WaspPart objects originates from a paired .3dm file. This is a prerequisite that affects the Wasp_Basic Part setup step and should be documented here so users know to open the .3dm first.
